 Billy Evans on "You Can See Everything"
 In his first TV interview, Billy Evans, partner of disgraced Theranos co-founder Elizabeth Holmes, talks with correspondent Matt Gutman about his characterization in the Nathan Fielder-Lance Oppenheim documentary "You Can See Everything." He also discusses threats he says have been made against his family's safety, and their children's experience during Holmes' prison sentence.
